user.title: Home Thermal Lab
user.description:
Set the outdoor temperature sensor, and the ground's yearly wave for below-ground rooms. The house itself (its rooms, how it is turned, its roofs, windows and walls) is House Structure's.

Then, on the integration's page, add the sensors in this order:
1. Heating-call statistics: one per zone (thermostat only).
2. Furnace energy: one for the blower (pick your whole-house power sensor and it learns the blower power) and one for the gas (type the furnace input in BTU/h).
3. Shadow zone (with sun): one per room. Leave the model blank and it learns it from the last 14 days.
4. Contribution chart: one per room, once you have its fitted terms.

data.ground_coldest_day: Ground temperature: coldest day of the year

data_description.outdoor_entity: Used by the shadow zone and the contribution chart.
data_description.ground_mean: For below-ground rooms without a ground sensor. Leave empty for the defaults (5.7, 5.6 and 95), measured at 1.8 m in Regina (hypothesis 03).
data_description.ground_swing: Half the gap between the warmest and coldest ground. About 0.4 of the air's swing at basement depth.
data_description.ground_coldest_day: Day of the year (1 to 365) the ground is coldest: roughly 70 days after the coldest air at basement depth.

user.title: Furnace energy
user.description: A modelled energy meter (kWh) for the energy dashboard, from the furnace state and a power for each state. Add one for the blower (kW, learned from a power sensor or typed) and one for the gas (the furnace input in BTU/h).

data.name: Name
data.power_entity: Whole-house power sensor (to learn the blower)
data.learn_days: Days of history to learn from (2-60)

data_description.climate_entities: Every zone's thermostat; the furnace state is read from all of them.
data_description.power_entity: Optional. Steps in this sensor when the furnace changes state set the fan and heating powers (needs several days; every 6 hours it refreshes). The powers typed below are used until then, and for any state it cannot learn.
data_description.power_unit: kW, or BTU/h for gas input (80,000 BTU/h is 23.4 kW). Stored in kW.
data_description.fan: Leave a state blank for zero.

user.title: Shadow zone (with sun)
user.description: Says whether a heating call starting now could be skipped, counting the sun on the room's windows and roofs in House Structure (hypothesis 17), and forecasts the room for the next day with a simulated thermostat (hypothesis 16). Nothing is switched. With a and c left empty, the model is learned from the recorder and refreshed every 6 hours; the shadow sensor's attributes show what it learned and how well it forecasts. Each zone also gets a Forecast and a Target sensor, and appears on the Zones tab of House Structure's Thermal Lab page.

data.name: Name
data.h: Heating rate h (degrees per hour of call), optional
data.target_swing: Target wave: swing (degrees either side of the mean)
data.target_band: Target wave: comfort band (degrees either side)

data_description.room_entity: Used instead of the thermostat's own reading when set.
data_description.a: Leave both empty to learn them from the last 14 days of history (a few days of data are needed first).
data_description.c: Leave both empty to learn them from the last 14 days of history (a few days of data are needed first).
data_description.tolerance: How far below the setpoint the room may drift.
data_description.max_dip: Skip a heating call only if the room stays within this of the setpoint.
data_description.g: Only used with a and c.
data_description.ground_entity: For a room House Structure marks below ground: an optional soil or ground temperature. Leave empty to use the annual ground wave set on the integration.
data_description.h: How fast the room warms while the furnace runs for this zone. Leave empty to learn it from the calls in the recorder.
data_description.deadband: How far below the setpoint a call starts, in the forecast's simulated thermostat (default 0.1; measured calls start a median 0.05 to 0.07 below).
data_description.target_mean: Leave empty to target the thermostat's setpoint instead of a daily wave.
data_description.target_peak_hour: Default 15 (3 pm): the outdoor wave peaks 1 to 3 hours after solar noon (hypothesis 02).
data_description.neighbours: Zones whose temperature and heating calls warm this one, for its learned model and forecast. Leave empty: the zone that heats most is every other zone's neighbour, and all the others are its.
data_description.area_id: The room in House Structure. Its windows, roofs, sunlit walls and below-ground setting come from there, and its thermostat (from the room's register) and room sensor unless you pick them below.
data_description.climate_entity: Leave empty to use the room's register in House Structure.

init.title: Forecast archive
init.description: The archive keeps every forecast the integration issues, in files the recorder does not purge. Records older than this many days are removed once a day. 0 keeps everything. The `home_thermal_lab.clear_archive` service removes records by kind, zone or date.

clear_archive.name: Clear the forecast archive
clear_archive.description: Remove archived forecasts: all of them, one kind, some zones, or everything before a date. It only reports what it would remove unless dry run is turned off.

zones.name: Zones
zones.description: Forecast sensor entity ids. Leave out for all zones. Applies to room records only.

before.name: Before
before.description: Remove records issued before this date (UTC). Leave out for everything.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Only report what would be removed (default on).
